name: The Chosen
tagline: A prophecy says you will save the world, or doom it. Big destiny, big weapon, and a fate the Keeper will keep throwing at you.
luckSpecial: Each time you spend a Luck point, the Keeper brings your fate into play and throws something from it at you.

moves.intro: On top of every basic move you get three Chosen moves. Two come automatically and you choose the third.

auto.name: Destiny's Plaything
auto.trig: At the start of each mystery, to see what your fate reveals about it
auto.full: The Keeper gives you a helpful fact about the upcoming mystery.
auto.part: You catch only a faint hint.
auto.miss: Something bad is headed your way.

auto.name: I'm Here For A Reason
auto.summary: Your fate gives you a specific job (decide what it is with the Keeper, using your fate as a guide). Until it is done you cannot die: if you are killed in play, spend a Luck point and you somehow return. The protection ends when the job is finished or when your Luck runs out.

choices.name: The Big Entrance
choices.trig: When you make a showy entrance into a dangerous situation
choices.full: The whole room stops and listens to your opening speech until you are done.
choices.part: Choose one person or monster, who stops to hear you out until you finish.
choices.miss: Every enemy present marks you as the biggest threat.

choices.name: Devastating
choices.summary: You can add +1 to the harm you deal.

choices.name: Dutiful
choices.summary: Whenever your fate comes into play and you act consistent with one of its tags, heroic or doom, mark experience. If the tag was heroic, you also get +1 forward.

choices.name: Invincible
choices.summary: You count as wearing 2-armour at all times. It does not add to other protection.

choices.name: Resilience
choices.summary: You recover quickly: whenever harm is healed on you, heal one extra point. The Keeper also treats your injuries as 1 harm lower when deciding on harm moves.

gear.title: Your special weapon
gear.intro: You carry a weapon you are fated to use. Build it by choosing one form, three business-end options and a material (for example handle, blade, long and magic make a magic sword).

extras.title: How you found out about your fate
Fate: heroic tags
extras.intro: Choose two heroic tags and two doom tags. Together they sketch how your fate plays out, and they may clash, which just means fate pulls you in two directions. Each time you spend Luck, the Keeper hits you with something out of your fate.

history: You are family by blood. Ask them how closely.
This hunter is fated to mentor you. Explain how that came to light.
They are your closest friend and you trust them fully.
At first they were a rival, but you reached a working arrangement.
There is romance between you, or you are fated to fall for each other.
You are ordinary friends, from school, work or the like. Ask them which.
They might have taken the Chosen One role instead of you, but they flunked a trial. Tell them how.
You rescued them before they knew monsters existed. Tell them what from.

improvements.text: Take a move from another playbook
Take a move from another playbook

advanced.text: Get back one used Luck point
Change this hunter to a new type
Create a second hunter to play as well as this one
Mark two of the basic moves as advanced
Mark another two of the basic moves as advanced
Delete one of your Doom tags, and optionally one of your Heroic tags: you have changed that part of your destiny
